scope: Ordinary Dogeminer 2 web parity; sequential implementation authorized October 14; original source/CE audit evidence retained

entries.title: Offline earnings
entries.description: DM2 credits 30% of total DPS for up to 24 hours after an absence exceeding five minutes, then reports it. CE restores balances and Mystery timers but does not credit offline mining. Add an idempotent credit so refresh/cloud load cannot pay twice.
entries.implementationDescription: Offline earnings. Implemented 30% of permanent total DPS after more than five minutes, capped at 24 hours. Atomic wallet/receipt persistence and deterministic replay prevent a second claim from the same snapshot. See the checkpoint test guide.

entries.title: SearchDoge discovery clock
entries.description: DM2 waits for play-time eligibility, searches every three seconds, uses a 17-second first-timeline interval and escalating success chances, and becomes faster after prestige. CE fills every empty offer slot immediately from eligible helpers. Preserve found offers and search timing per planet.
entries.implementationDescription: SearchDoge discovery clock. Implemented source eligibility, three-second checks, 17-second first-timeline interval, escalating chances and faster prestige discovery. Existing offers, failed attempts and active clocks persist per planet; rendering no longer fills slots.

entries.title: Upgrade count means found offers
entries.description: DM2's badge counts discovered offers in the three slots, with appear/pop/hide feedback. CE counts every eligible helper type, including upgrades outside the displayed slots. Align with M02 while keeping the corrected unclipped corner position.
entries.implementationDescription: Upgrade count means found offers. Badge now counts only valid discovered offers in unlocked slots on the current planet, with show/pop/hide feedback. Unaffordable found offers count; unfound eligible helpers do not. Existing corner placement/colors retained.

entries.title: Johnny Silverpaw progression
entries.description: DM2's last Titan helper is Johnny Silverpaw, upgraded through versions 2.0 and 3.0; those milestones drive later unlocks. CE substitutes an Altar of the SunDoge with the same base income/coin tier numbers but different art, names, descriptions, and progression. Decide whether to retain the Altar reskin or restore Johnny.
entries.implementationDescription: Retain the CE Altar skin/names/descriptions; map source helper34 stage1/stage2 progression, Yoga/blueprint/Reallyhardium dependencies and15/25 diamond alternatives onto it.
entries.sourceClarification: CE Altar artwork, tier names and descriptions are retained as existing CE content. Source helper34 progression, payments and unlocks are mapped onto the skin; no claim that CE art/text has been replaced by Johnny.

entries.title: Robo-Yoga upgrade unlock wave
entries.description: Johnny 2.0 unlocks Cloud Base tiers 2–4, Robo Shibe tiers 2–4, D-Rex tier 4, and Johnny tier 2. CE gates only terminal upgrades on the first Altar upgrade; intermediate locked source tiers become available prematurely.
entries.implementationDescription: Source Altar/helper34 stage1 and arrival>5500ms unlock exactly eight Yoga tiers; saved milestone and announcement commit before availability.

entries.title: Blueprint and Reallyhardium unlock wave
entries.description: DM2 drops a blueprint artifact after a Robo Shibe or Heavy Walker is owned on Titan. Johnny 3.0 plus the blueprint unlocks 27 specified late tiers across planets and sets the Reallyhardium flag. CE has no artifact or discovery flags and uses Altar level 1 as the terminal-tier gate.
entries.implementationDescription: Altar stage2 plus field/collected blueprint and arrival>1300ms unlock the exact27 source metal tiers and repeats. Legacy earned tiers retain access; old blanket Altar1 gate removed.

entries.title: Rig unlock before Jupiter
entries.description: DM2 invents the Time Machine Rig after 25 Party Shibes, two Space Basses, or progress beyond Mars. CE locks it until Jupiter is unlocked. This also delays the first D.I.A. contact; integrate with S14/S15.
entries.implementationDescription: Rig invention now follows 25 Party Shibes, two Space Basses or a visit beyond Mars, with the source 1250ms delay and durable purchase/travel gates. Existing CE rig access is preserved.

entries.title: Prestige diamonds from coins
entries.description: DM2 uses ceil(ceil(coins / 1,000,000)^0.4), minimum 1 and maximum 60 for mission 1. CE uses floor(log10(max(10, coins)) × 2), capped at 60. At one million coins DM2 gives 1 versus CE's 12; at one trillion, 60 versus 24.
entries.implementationDescription: Future mission coin diamonds use ceil(ceil(coins / 1,000,000)^0.4), minimum 1 and maximum 60. Source fixtures and real quote/reward/save checks pass; existing diamonds remain intact.

entries.title: Prestige diamonds from pickaxes
entries.description: DM2 gives ceil(pickaxe count / 2), including the starting pickaxe. CE excludes its starting pickaxe and pays 1/2/4/8/16 by rarity. A Paw plus seven legendary pickaxes gives DM2 4 versus CE 112. Change future payouts only under an approved migration policy.
entries.implementationDescription: Future pickaxe diamonds use ceil(owned count / 2), including the starting pickaxe and duplicate copies, independent of rarity and without a cap. Existing earned rewards remain intact.

entries.title: D.I.A. badge strength
entries.description: DM2 derives the badge roll from planet-weighted owned helper counts, a 230 cap, and a timeline-dependent calculation above the cap. CE gives floor(33 × 1.09^timeline) regardless of helpers. Ten Earth Shibes on timeline 1 produce DM2 4 versus CE 35; 1,000 produce 230 versus 35.
entries.implementationDescription: Future D.I.A. badges use source helper counts rounded per type and planet, the strict 230 threshold and later-timeline growth, including the timeline 10/11 boundary. Grouping does not change counts. Earned badge values are preserved and receive the new reward.

entries.title: Timeline history and mission-choice records
entries.description: DM2 saves per-timeline coin/earned-coin/play-time history and Kitler choices, and restarts the current timeline's earned-coin/play-time counters. CE has lifetime totals and a timeline number but no equivalent history or recorded choice. Keep lifetime CE stats while adding current-run fields.
entries.implementationDescription: Current-run earned coins and active mining time plus durable per-timeline wallet/earned/time/actual mission choice/badge/diamond records. New run counters reset; CE lifetime totals remain. Legacy later saves start with known minimums and no invented records.

entries.title: Protected fortune consolidation
entries.description: DM2 merges duplicate fortune IDs and sums/floors their stat totals after prestige. CE merges Super Fortunes and same-type D.I.A. badges, but other protected duplicate types remain separate. Preserve all earned values while deciding how CE's grid should display merged copies.
entries.implementationDescription: Future prestige groups duplicate protected source IDs into original-artwork ×N tiles, preserving fixed/seasonal/fractional Alpha totals and existing stack counts. Inventory, rewards and history commit with primary/backup rollback and safe retry.

entries.title: DJ Kittenz royalties
entries.description: With five DJ Kittenz on Mars, sufficient current-run time, and the location delay, DM2 grants a once-per-timeline flat DPS reward of 300 × timeline + 500. CE has no royalty award, seen flag, or extrapersec equivalent. The story callback must grant even when stories are disabled.
entries.implementationDescription: Five owned DJ Kittenz on current Mars, 730 whole current-run seconds, focus and strict >8200ms arrival gate. Once-per-timeline 300×timeline+500 flat DPS commits on story completion, enters permanent/offline income before total multipliers, persists through travel/reload, and clears on prestige without becoming item stats.

entries.title: Doge Gate base cost
entries.description: DM2 costs 123,456,789; CE uses 123,000,000. Other base helper numbers and finite coin/income tiers match in the automated catalog comparison, after mapping Johnny to the Altar.
entries.implementationDescription: Doge Gate base cost corrected to source123,456,789; existing scaling/supporter discount retained. Exact purchase, next price and saved ownership verified.

entries.title: Johnny/Altar diamond purchase options
entries.description: DM2 offers diamond payments of 15 and 25 for Johnny's two upgrades. CE's Altar versions omit both diamond prices/buttons. Depends on the content choice in M04.
entries.implementationDescription: Altar diamond alternatives match source helper34:15/25. Both currencies use one durable tier/payment/offer/scouting-pause transaction with primary/backup rollback.

entries.title: Dual-wielding duplicate pickaxes
entries.description: DM2 pairs the equipped item with another copy of the same template, renders a second hand, alternates swings, and rolls a 40% double attack. CE keeps duplicate items but has one equipped sprite and no paired attack. Ascended Staff is explicitly excluded in DM2.
entries.implementationDescription: Duplicate equipped template pairs except Ascended Staff; alternating hands and source40% double damage roll, equipped stats only/rock cap, rear hand and durable discovery toast.

entries.title: SunDoge fusion
entries.description: Two Staffs of the SunDoge trigger a fusion sequence; the resulting legendary Ascended Staff has zero DPC and ten times the newest staff's original passive-DPS roll. CE includes its balance definition but has no fusion transaction, playable template, rendering, or saved discovery state.
entries.implementationDescription: Newest two staffs fuse atomically into a playable fusion-only legendary Ascended Staff:0 DPC/10× newest stored passive DPS roll; source default Magic phases with CE solid-stroke presentation, rollback/retry/stale guards and pending-discovery reload recovery.

entries.title: Hold-to-mine drills
entries.description: DM2's Huge Drill, Golden Huge Drill, and Unstable Drill use auger/jackhammer profiles with sustained input, vibration, cutting/contact phases, audio, and pause/resume handling. CE swings these as ordinary tools and mines once per press.
entries.implementationDescription: Held auger/jackhammer mining uses active source cadence/profiles/pose math, critical rules/5% chatter, equip gate, pause/resume/rebite and pointer/Space/controller release/cancel/blur/disconnect; no offline hit burst, motion preferences honored.

entries.title: Record critical hits
entries.description: DM2 tracks highestcrit, saves it, and gives record-breaking crits a 30% larger pop, dark finish, and short recoil. CE has normal crit styling and highest DPS, but no highest-crit record or distinct record animation.
entries.implementationDescription: Saved lifetime records.highestcrit tracks strictly greater finite critical damage after the remaining-rock cap, independently of effects budgets. Source1.3x pop, exact210ms recoil and dark Canvas tint; no glow. Existing currency flight remains separate. Legacy/invalid records normalize safely; ordinary save/import/refresh, prestige preservation and full-reset clearing. Highest Critical Hit added to existing desktop/phone Statistics; no earned item-stat migration.

entries.title: Bonus Coin boost and duration values
entries.description: Earth matches +50%/60s. DM2's remaining tiers are +60%/60s, +70%/75s, +90%/90s, +110%/105s, +150%/120s. CE uses +60%/90s, +70%/120s, +80%/120s, +90%/120s, +100%/180s. Correct the gameplay values and displayed timers together.
entries.implementationDescription: All six source names/boosts/durations apply to future claims; immediate HUD/DPS/DPC activation and expiry are verified. Existing saved Alpha multiplier/deadline values are retained.

entries.title: Bonus Coin selection and unlock rules
entries.description: DM2 samples all unlocked tiers with weights 40/25/15/10/6/4; reached planets unlock tiers, and timeline 2 unlocks the best tier. CE always spawns its highest tier, requires owning bases, and reserves the best tier for the Altar upgrade.
entries.implementationDescription: Source weighted pool uses reached planets and timeline-2 tier six. Field offers and claimed HUD identity are frozen, duplicate/stale claims are rejected, and reached-planet state resets on prestige.

entries.title: Bonus Coin spawn and collection rhythm
entries.description: DM2's two-minute checks start at 22% chance, increase by 22 points after failures, and force an early bonus after nine Mining Shibes. The on-field lifetime is eight seconds. CE schedules 2.5–5 minutes unconditionally, has no forced early offer, and leaves the coin for twelve seconds.
entries.implementationDescription: Independent 120-second checks use escalating 22-point odds and an eight-second field lifetime. A saved one-shot first offer requires nine Mining Shibes and coins >10; lifetime claims/history survive prestige. Hidden/paused checks skip safely.

entries.title: Prestige auto-pickup
entries.description: After the first prestige DM2 unlocks/enables auto-pickup. It collects coins/diamonds and opens bags automatically, sends loot to inventory, and equips new pickaxes. CE has no equivalent unlock, toggle, or field automation. Keep manual review when the toggle is off.
entries.implementationDescription: First-prestige seven-second unlock; saved independent off/on preference; new-drop coin/diamond/bag automation at source 200+628ms. Atomic bag consume/reward/unread/auto-equip before effects, frozen retry, normal delayed currency HUD, manual old-stash retention and source item reveal/fly timings. Works independently of CE mobile helper bar.

entries.title: Helper coin pickup
entries.description: DM2's canloot helpers collect nearby coin piles after a 1.8-second eligibility delay and dip when collecting. Mining/Moon/Party/Super/Robo Shibes and Coin Seeker qualify. CE's helpers mine but never collect loose coins.
entries.implementationDescription: Six source canloot helper types collect nearby coins after the 1800ms landing delay, closest within source 100px, newest-first and one per helper each 500ms poll. Existing atomic coin claims, retry and delayed HUD flights are reused; held/moving helpers are excluded.
entries.implementationNotes: Applies to visible field helpers. CE retains its grouped mobile bar; hidden sprites cannot collect, and only private phone previews temporarily expose field actors.

entries.title: Coin-seeking helper movement
entries.description: DM2 helpers hop toward coins beyond pickup range, choose targets, limit concurrent seekers, and navigate obstacles. CE has no seeking state or autonomous movement. Use CE group membership carefully so a visual group cannot lose saved members.
entries.implementationDescription: Source target planner, seeker caps/separation, retargeting, loop-aligned hop timing, detours, bounded collision fitting and gentle peer bumps are implemented. CE groups move all members together without changing names/IDs/ownership, and pause/drag/reset guards cancel stale movement.
entries.implementationNotes: Applies to visible field helpers. CE retains its grouped mobile bar; hidden sprites cannot collect, and only private phone previews temporarily expose field actors.

entries.title: Collect all loose coins
entries.description: In DM2, collecting a coin pile or opening a bag collects other loose coin piles too. CE collects only the clicked pile and leaves other coin piles during bag opening. Use one transaction per pile and preserve delayed HUD credit.
entries.implementationDescription: Opening a new ordinary/stacked bag view gathers current-field loose coins with atomic wallet persistence, one flight per pile and delayed HUD credit. Source correction: individual coin clicks collect just that pile; the original audit overstated that branch.

sourceCorrection.description: wC binds coin pointerdown to single-pile kC. TC("coins") appears in ordinary and stacked bag opening branches, not the coin branch. Preserve individual coin clicks.

entries.title: Persistent diamond field stacks
entries.description: DM2 stacks unclaimed diamonds, saves them per planet, caps a stack at 999, and keeps them until collected. CE still renders individual diamonds that disappear after about 17.5 seconds and are not restored on refresh/travel. Bag persistence already exists; extend it to diamonds.
entries.implementationDescription: Per-planet unclaimed diamond stacks now persist across travel/refresh without expiry, cap at source 999 and credit excess drops directly. Claims commit wallet/removal atomically, preserve delayed HUD display and reject stale/duplicate input; source prestige/reset clears field stacks.

implementationFollowUps.description: Explicit source ghost/main painting order, proportional offsets and source-relative count anchor.

entries.title: Four unavailable Mystery Box fortunes
entries.description: DM2's seven additional Mystery fortunes include Mining Site Map, Enchanted Red Gem, Enchanted Green Gem, and Huge Enchanted Green Gem. CE has their numeric definitions but no loaded factory templates, so getMysteryLootPool skips them. Add their art/templates and coverage; the existing timing/kind rules already match.
entries.implementationDescription: Loaded all four missing Mystery-only fortune templates with original local art/descriptions and source rarity/default rolls. All seven special fortunes resolve across all 20 planet/tier pools; ordinary bags exclude the restored four.

entries.title: Rock replacement timing and blocked-loot behavior
entries.description: DM2 waits 250ms, checks whether a non-stacked chest/reward view blocks replacement, then waits another 500ms before respawn. CE replaces after a fixed 500ms. Decide whether to copy DM2's blocked-loot rule along with timing; ordinary bag stacks themselves do not block it.
entries.implementationDescription: 250ms capacity polling and500ms replacement after the four bag-quality counts fall below99. Keep earned overflow; small capacity hint, next-rock persistence and stale epoch/record guards.
entries.sourceClarification: The active c_ predicate at34273 checks each of four bag counts for>=99. The original audit description confused this with the separate non-stack-bag gate used by Rick. Original audit fields are retained.

entries.title: Cloud/local progress reconciliation
entries.description: DM2 selects valid local/cloud progress by timeline, then earned coins, with timestamp tie-breaking in some paths. CE's silent cloud loader applies remote gameData whenever present, without comparing it to newer local progress. Cloud saving exists; the missing part is conflict selection.
entries.implementationDescription: Validated timeline/earned-progress/time comparison on reads and transactional uploads; account/reset guards, reward deferral, atomic pre-cloud recovery and supporter separation.

entries.title: DM2 save conversion
entries.description: DM2 exports compressed .doge saves (LZString Base64/UTF16). CE accepts its own JSON format only. A converter must map inventory rolls, helper tiers/positions, discoveries, field stacks, timelines, and settings; retain an original backup before importing.
entries.implementationDescription: Read-only DM2 Base64/UTF16/JSON conversion with stored item rolls, protected rewards, helper tiers/names/positions, progression, stacks/history/settings and atomic original/pre-import recovery.

entries.title: Hold-to-reveal Buy Max
entries.description: DM2's buy buttons have a hold gesture that reveals Buy Max, previews affordability/count, and buys up to 100 helpers in an animated burst, stopping if funds/location eligibility change. CE buys one helper per activation and has no bulk-buy gesture.
entries.implementationDescription: Source 500ms hold, upward reveal/selection, buy-one release and 1600ms lingering option; live count/cost quote capped at 100. Executed source 600ms burst cadence, CE rounded prices, per-wave atomic ownership/placement save with rollback, funds/location/epoch guards, forced bulk auto-place without preference changes, phone grouped bar and keyboard access.

entries.title: Loose-coin lifetime
entries.description: DM2 schedules loose coin warning after about six seconds plus a small random delay, then removes it after roughly three more seconds. CE waits eight seconds, warns for five, then fades for half a second. Diamonds should use M27's permanent stack path rather than this expiry path.
entries.implementationDescription: Loose coins now warn after source 6001–6666ms and remove 3030ms later, with source fade phases and a reduced-motion fade. Collection, reset and travel dispose timers/hover effects; diamonds use their permanent ledger instead.

entries.title: NewsDoge ticker
entries.description: DM2 has 22 active progress-conditioned news reports across the five planets, a bounded queue, planet colors, scrolling text, and a clickable reporter with annoyed reactions. CE contains no news renderer or report criteria. The unused #news-container exclusion is not an implementation.
entries.implementationDescription: Completed the Checkpoint 6 preview after live DM2 verification: compact 36px scrolling bar even under reduced motion, source position/fonts/label widths, exact news1 sound and all three original atlas-extracted reporter expressions. Reactions restore after 700ms; scrolling completion safely closes the report. All 22 source reports and saved queue behavior remain covered.
entries.reviewFollowUp: Corrected source logical-to-display scaling and exact reporter entry/exit curves/phases after user review; verified actual intermediate motion in normal and reduced modes.

entries.title: Unread pickaxe/fortune counters
entries.description: DM2 counts new items and clears those counts when the relevant inventory is visited. CE updates item previews but has no unread counters/badges or saved unread state.
entries.implementationDescription: Separate saved pickaxe/fortune unread counters now follow grants and inventory visits, with old-save defaults, independent clearing, failed-write retry and prestige/reset handling.

entries.title: All aggregate item stats
entries.description: DM2's total-stat panel includes every rolled attribute besides click value. CE shows a fixed eight-line core sidebar, excluding Mystery Bonus, Staff total-DPS percentage, and summed flavor attributes. Show totals without presenting cosmetic attributes as gameplay modifiers.
entries.implementationDescription: Inventory totals now include Mystery Bonus, total-DPS multiplier and every other rolled attribute from the equipped pickaxe/all fortunes. Aliases/signs/units and earned consolidated totals are handled; flavor attributes are labeled without mining effects.

entries.title: Stat explanations reflect current mechanics
entries.description: DM2 explains Wow as improving future loot stats and Loot Find as improving loot chances. CE's explanation still says Loot Find increases coin rewards and barely explains Wow; this predates the balance migration. Update that copy, while retaining Mystery's intentionally cryptic explanation.
entries.implementationDescription: Stat explanations now describe Wow improving new loot rolls, Loot Find improving loot chances and current critical damage. Removed the stale base 5% claim; Mystery remains cryptic.

entries.title: Complete attribute color mapping
entries.description: CE maps the main stat colors but ignores several source tags. Examples: Higher Ground is sand-colored in DM2 but green in CE; Discipline/Dancing use blue; Helper Morale uses cyan. Prefer the pinned attribute metadata over the current small name-based switch.
entries.implementationDescription: The complete 33-attribute source metadata/colors now drive fortune inventory and loot details, including sand Higher Ground, blue Discipline/Dancing and cyan Helper Morale. Pickaxe Equip lines retain source green.

entries.title: Large Dogebag receipt overflow
entries.description: DM2 displays up to ten item minis on desktop and four on phone, then a +N overflow receipt, while every reward remains reviewable. CE renders every item mini and scales the whole tray down with no minimum, making a large opening unreadable. Currency remains consolidated in both.
entries.implementationDescription: Large openings show source ten desktop/four phone item minis followed by a +N receipt, plus consolidated currencies. Every reward stays mapped/reviewable; resize during flight, overflow review state, early close and durable batch ownership are verified.

entries.title: Upgrade card hover
entries.description: DM2 upgrades have a 2px lift, soft shadow, and 11% highlight. CE's source-style shop hover is present, but the upgrade renderer has no corresponding card-hover behavior. Keep the user's preference for solid borders and soft shadows.
entries.implementationDescription: Executed source2px flat lift,100ms entry/settle,11% additive background highlight over120ms,22% soft shadow with2px drop/6px spread/14px radius. Found desktop offers and keyboard focus only; preserve empty/locked/phone cards and purchase fades, suppress lift with reduced motion. No extra RAF, economy mutation or glow.

reviewFollowUps.description: User requested a softer shadow: 16% black, 2px drop, 3px spread, 12px radius. Preserve the accepted lift, highlight, timing, purchase fades and phone/reduced-motion behavior.

entries.title: Upgrade applying and helper transformation
entries.description: DM2 shows an applying state, removes the purchased offer, and transforms affected helper sprites with completion feedback. CE changes helper data immediately and fades/replaces the offer in about 400ms. Compare the source transformation sequence after M02/M05/M06.
entries.implementationDescription: Durable purchase starts APPLYING,500ms card/payment feedback, source staggered Ao texture fade/scale/rotation and DONE1000ms fade. Preserve groups/names, cancel stale jobs and add visible phone-card feedback beside helper bar.

entries.title: Button press/release/pop feedback
entries.description: DM2's shared buttons and close controls have lift, press squash, spring release, and pop-in states. CE uses CSS hover/active behavior and separate animations in some dialogs; the full shared motion treatment is absent. Apply selectively to existing two-tone CE controls.
entries.implementationDescription: Source popup/buy lift, press squash, Back/Elastic release and popup/close pop-in profiles adapted to existing two-tone CE controls. Preserve popup anchoring throughout motion, carry release across shop redraw, deduplicate inputs, respect reduced motion, clean canceled/disabled/detached states and exclude Buy Max own action. Mining feedback is corrected in the review follow-up to source20% independent rolls and uncapped circular placement around Doge.

entries.title: Rich event notifications
entries.description: DM2 supports distinct quest/info/achievement artwork, title/detail/icon fields, callbacks, and clickable navigation (for example, a found-upgrade notification opens its slot). CE's notification manager reduces messages to plain text and ignores most type distinctions.
entries.implementationDescription: Source info frame, title/info/details/icon fields, safe color tags, one-shot body/close/end semantics, default6000ms/custom/staying lifecycle and found-upgrade navigation. Reuse source FASTER story fields and biblip once. Add a separate silent persistent Reduce Motion notice as requested, respecting system preference and tab-session acknowledgment.
entries.sourceClarification: Original artwork inference narrowed by current source/atlas: quest/achievement config exists, but texture paths return404 and only411x181 info artwork ships; all active ordinary bc callers useinfo. Use the available source artwork without inventing or activating dormant features.
entries.presentationOverride: User review: remove red X, shrink desktop/phone notices20%, use4500ms default instead of source6000ms, and align Reduce Motion heading left/down with the small circular alert. Custom/staying timers and body activation remain.

entries.title: Doge/pickaxe hover tilt and idle sway
entries.description: DM2 subtly follows the pointer with separate Doge/pickaxe transforms and an idle Doge sway, disabled on phones. CE has mining bounce, floating entry, and held-helper sway, but no corresponding main-character/pickaxe hover system.
entries.sourceClarification: Source configuration/gate verification, not full-start source gameplay certification; loader/native timeout limitations are recorded in the checkpoint report.
entries.implementationDescription: Original missing-feature classification corrected: live exported source defaults/configs are disabled and unarmed. The exact source gate stays off with renderer references; explicit-enable positive control and phone suppression are tested. No extra CE motion added.

entries.title: Tool-specific swing/layer behavior
entries.description: DM2 item metadata controls special swing tweens, hidden idle tools, behind-character layering, and hit/crit sounds. CE detects a few names/file patterns and mostly uses one generic swing path. Audit each tool family while adding drills and dual-wielding.
entries.implementationDescription: Active catalog rear/hidden/use-sprite metadata,175ms extra texture, source normal swing/input timings and phone staff scale. Correct sprite-basename size selection; retain CE Paw positioning and fit narrow phone pairs. Dormant tween branches stay inactive.
entries.sourceClarification: The active base catalog contains no tween assignments. Source specialPick/specialUnpick mini/knife/glove branches are dormant; implement active metadata and generic swing rather than inventing family-specific tweens.

entries.title: Mining/helper chatter
entries.description: DM2 rolls mining phrases and has helper-specific idle, held, and after-drop chatter, plus rocket location phrases and DJ/Cate variants. CE has introductory/mission speech and names but no ordinary field chatter system.
entries.implementationDescription: Source-derived accepted-hit mining phrases; 500ms population-dependent idle chatter, named held/after chances and delays, Cat/DJ/destination pools and tool overrides. Bounded solid-stroke DOM text follows held motion; pause, stale-field, hidden-page and cleanup guards. Source empty icon entries remain silent.
entries.sourceClarification: Executed definitions gate ordinary rocket chatter off; Lander Shibe10 uses destination text. Only Johnny34 declares extraFrames; its reskin/art remains M04.

entries.title: Helper animation cadence and frames
entries.description: DM2 gives helpers type-dependent randomized animation speeds and uses extra frame sequences where available. CE generally alternates two frames at fixed 3fps, with 1fps for rigs/drives; the held-speed animation is already implemented. Preserve CE's held motion while matching rest animation profiles.
entries.implementationDescription: Source randomized type profiles and full available-frame ordering, including repeated idle frame, in one shared deadline scheduler. Preserve rest rate/phase through holding; owned phone-bar profiles, hidden/reduced-motion pauses and upgrade refresh. CE Altar textures remain under M04; source Johnny art is not substituted.
entries.sourceClarification: Executed definitions gate ordinary rocket chatter off; Lander Shibe10 uses destination text. Only Johnny34 declares extraFrames; its reskin/art remains M04.

entries.title: Helper hover outline and fade
entries.description: DM2 shows a solid hover outline, lifts the helper's drawing order, and fades its name for roughly one second after leaving. CE shows a separate name tooltip and grouping control, with a different fade/depth treatment. Keep saved group names and controller focus support.
entries.implementationDescription: Executed source solid 2px amber silhouette, immediate 14px stroked name, one-second fade and resting/fading/hovered/held depth order. Retain keyboard focus, selection/Rick strokes, grouped identities and held motion; no glows or per-frame hover loop.

entries.title: Moon launch controls and introduction
entries.description: DM2 has a press-to-initiate rocket screen, play/pause, volume controls, video fallback link, and a skip confirmation. CE plays the launch video directly with a delayed skip button, without those controls. Use the player's mute setting when integrating video audio.
entries.implementationDescription: Press-to-initiate Moon screen,20% volume/5% steps, play/pause, desktop fallback link and armed skip confirmation. Save completion before travel; retry failures and clean up input/media/focus on replacement.

entries.title: Known planet versus unlocked planet display
entries.description: DM2 separately tracks known, unlocked, and visited locations; discovered targets can appear locked before a rocket/DogeStar is owned. CE usually hides Mars/Jupiter/Titan tabs until travel is available, and requires the Titan Sensor Package as well as DogeStar even though source travel unlock is driven by DogeStar.
entries.implementationDescription: The known/unlocked/visited ledger and interactive locked-tab feedback now cover Mars, Jupiter and Titan on desktop/mobile. Source Sensor discovery and independent DogeStar travel complete the Checkpoint 7 partial implementation.

entries.title: Background pools and change rhythm
entries.description: DM2 uses per-location background lists and a ten-second change cycle. CE uses a fifteen-second cycle and substitutes its Earth pool on Moon; the other pools also differ. Use existing local art where possible and review any intentional CE backgrounds.
entries.implementationDescription: Source ordinary per-planet pools/order and ten-second sequential timer; existing24 images across31 pool entries, source four-second opacity fade/top-left cover crop/colors. Shared selection for startup/load/import/travel/prestige, two display layers, cached ready images and stale/failure guards. Preserve reduced motion and skip automatic changes while paused/hidden/in cutscenes/transitions. Routine save-success notice removed as separately requested.

entries.title: Patch notes and update notice UI
entries.description: DM2 has an in-game patch-note viewer, persisted seen/open state, version checking, reload-to-update action, focus trapping, and key isolation. CE shows a static Beta version label and the balance migration report, with no comparable release-note flow.
entries.implementationDescription: Version-label CE patch-note viewer with planet theme, panel-relative zoom, scrollable feed, keyboard/controller isolation and local seen/open preferences. Startup/focus/30-minute version checks with five-minute throttle/three-failure cap; new-build marker, atomic save before reload and session reload-loop protection.
entries.polishNotes: Read notes return the footer to the version alone without an underline; keep NEW PATCH NOTES and UPDATE AVAILABLE, separated unread dot, keyboard/controller access and durable update guards.

entries.title: Browser title balance
entries.description: DM2 updates the tab title with the live Dogecoin balance while playing. CE leaves the document title static.
entries.implementationDescription: Checkpoint14 balance-title behavior removed at the user request in Checkpoint15. Static Dogeminer:CE title; HUD currency flight behavior retained.
entries.omissionReason: User explicitly requested removal of the Dogecoin amount from the browser tab on October16. Keep the game name static; no toggle or pending implementation.

entries.title: Landing-page continuation/import
entries.description: DM2's landing action changes to Continue when a save exists and validates uploaded DM2 saves. CE always says Start and imports only from its in-game settings. Keep CE branding and connect conversion to M31.
entries.implementationDescription: CE Start/Continue from supported local/backup save; read-only CE/DM2 file review, session handoff to atomic game import, original/pre-import recovery and durable request replay protection; relative same-origin navigation.

entries.implementationDescription: Saved Mute Rock Sounds preference independently gates pick/weapon/critical/ground/rock-stage effects, retains loot/UI/music, synchronizes compact desktop/mobile controls and rolls back failed persistence. Source true default preserves older saves.

Blur/focus/visibility gates new effects and mutes playing tracks in place, including lazy tracks and mission/video media. Preserve explicit effects/music settings, cutscene suspension and external Howler global mute. Desktop/mobile sync and save failure rollback.

entries.title: Less Effects mode
entries.description: DM2 offers a user-controlled performance mode reducing render work/effects. CE respects reduced motion in newer effects but has no comparable in-game low-effects setting. Retain reduced motion support as well.
entries.implementationDescription: Saved false-default Less Effects on standard desktop/mobile rows. Suppress new mining particles/smoke and currency flights, retain HUD gain feedback, actual damage/income, logical claim persistence and existing flight cleanup. Independent OS reduced motion; shared setter sync/rollback.

Main/helper/loot/Buy Max callbacks and in-container CSS/Web Animations share capped presentation with real elapsed time and exact completion/cancel/resume behavior. Native cursor/controller polling remains independent. Smooth passive income uses source72ms under the cap without changing explicit CE saved rates. Load/import/rollback sync the clock.

entries.title: Tablet/desktop/phone layout choices
entries.description: DM2 has three layout profiles and explicit device/layout options. CE provides desktop/mobile responsiveness and Force Mobile UI, with no dedicated tablet mode or equivalent desktop override.
entries.implementationDescription: Saved Automatic/Desktop/Tablet/Phone choices, dedicated tablet proportions/compact tabs/touch sizing, fixed-profile screen fitting and an always-accessible recovery selector; source import and legacy Force Mobile preferences adopted.

entries.implementationDescription: Saved post-prestige Holiday Events and existing Auto-Pickup Loot controls; live consumers, both desktop and mobile.

entries.description: DM2 supports horizontal swipe tab navigation and a vertical gesture for its mobile panel, with threshold/duration and mining-start guards. CE opens its explicit mobile menu and switches tabs by buttons/controller; no matching swipe handler was found.

CE retains its grid, browses details without equipping and closes via panel header to preserve native content scrolling. Guard mining/control/drag origins, blocking dialogs, multitouch/cancel/resize/blur and compatibility clicks; desktop unchanged.

groups.title: Design differences to retain or approve separately

entries.title: CE grid inventory
entries.description: The user chose CE's searchable grid, filters, sorting, stats sidebar, and controller/touch navigation. Retain it; do not replace it with DM2's three-card desktop/one-card phone carousel. Square rarity tiles, item tilt, DPC comparison, details, and badges already exist.

entries.title: Solid strokes instead of glows
entries.description: The user explicitly prefers crisp rarity strokes and avoiding glows. DM2 uses some halos, bloom, and luminous effects; copying those is not the target. New fusion/holiday/notification work should preserve this preference.

entries.title: Bag stack capacity
entries.description: DM2 caps each bag-quality stash at 99; unmerged overflow behaves differently. CE deliberately preserves saved counts above 99 and shows the full-style badge from 99 onward. Choose a future capacity/overflow rule without deleting earned CE bags.

entries.title: Supporter reward policy
entries.description: CE intentionally retains its advertised always-double Mystery Box perk and its own supporter service. DM2 Patron also gives +5 diamonds per mission, which CE omits. DM2 has provider-dependent ad/bribe flows. Decide which perks/monetization belong in CE; do not silently copy a payment/ad integration.

entries.title: Earned Super Fortunes and Alpha rescue
entries.description: The user explicitly chose preserving merged Alpha bonuses, fixed items, and protected rewards. CE's migration/one-time rock rescue differs from a clean DM2 run on purpose. Future badge/payout changes must keep earned items unless a separate policy is approved.

entries.title: Paw final-hit behavior
entries.description: CE forces Paw hits to exactly 1 with no crit/buff/supporter multiplier, honoring its asset instruction. DM2 fixes the Paw's generated base click roll but uses its normal mining crit/bonus/supporter path. Choose whether to keep CE's stricter gameplay rule.

entries.title: Controller, grouping, customization, and CE content
entries.description: Keep CE controller cursor mode, helper grouping/names, extra tabs, and the existing custom content. They are CE additions. A functional Hats tab and Pickaxe Trees are CE roadmap work; this DM2 web build has no equivalent wearable menu or branching pickaxe tree to clone. Johnny/Altar replacement remains a separate M04 choice.

entries.title: Timer persistence policy
entries.description: CE persists Bonus Coin buffs across refresh and advances Mystery cooldown while offline. DM2 Bonus Coin state lives in its session game object; Mystery countdown decrements saved remaining time during the session, with no offline subtraction found in loadGame. Choose whether to keep CE's persistence conveniences.

entries.title: Web versus native/platform parity
entries.description: The bundle includes Steam/CrazyGames branches, achievements, demo/full save slots, native cloud/settings, rich presence, and provider pause/reward flows. These are not active features of the ordinary dogeminer2.com browser session. Treat platform parity as its own project scope.

entries.title: Bag claim persistence and geometry adaptations
entries.description: CE saves logical item/currency grants before animation and withholds only HUD credit, as the user requested. Bag landing positions adapt source polar coordinates to CE's rock scale/panel bounds. Keep these guarantees; pixel coordinates from a different canvas layout should not be pasted directly.

entries.title: Phone shop/upgrade panel structure
entries.description: DM2 phone shop/upgrade views page horizontally with one card/slot visible and position dots. CE uses its scrollable mobile shop and dense three-slot upgrade panel. Keep the recently requested CE slot density unless full source-style paging is explicitly approved; Q10's tab swipes can be added independently.
